brief.zh: 一张印着字母的旧照片，满是噪点（ᾱ = 0.9）。这次不知道噪声是什么：训练一个元件从照片里猜出噪声，还原照片，再标出字的笔画。
brief.en: An old photo of a letter, full of grain (ᾱ = 0.9). This time the noise is unknown: train a part to guess the noise from the photo, restore the photo, then mark the strokes of the letter.

hint.zh: 噪声每一格都不一样，字的笔画却连成一片。一格和它的邻居差得多，多半是噪声。
hint.en: The noise differs from cell to cell, but the strokes of a letter join up. A cell very different from its neighbours is probably noise.

after.zh: 你训练的 3×3 核学会了「和邻居差得多的是噪声」，还原以后笔画就清楚了。扩散模型的去噪网络大得多，从纯噪声出发一步步猜噪声、去掉一点，最后画出一张没见过的图：每一步做的都是这一关的事。
after.en: The 3×3 kernel you trained learnt that "what differs a lot from its neighbours is noise", and after restoring, the strokes are clear. A diffusion model's denoising network is far bigger: starting from pure noise it guesses the noise and removes a little, step after step, until a picture never seen before appears. Every step does what this level does.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="own-8-10"></part-ref>由 x_t 和噪声 ε 还原 x₀。可真要用的时候，没人告诉你噪声是什么。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-8-10"></part-ref> in the tray recovers x₀ from x_t and the noise ε. But when it is actually needed, nobody tells you what the noise was.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:learn3"></part-ref>可以训练：按训练，它自己调权重。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:learn3"></part-ref> can be trained: press Train and it adjusts its own weights.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：修好一张满是噪点的旧照片，再标出字的笔画。
t.en: Your task in this level: mend an old photo full of grain, then mark the strokes of the letter.
